chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Al-Harith ibn Muhammad ibn Al-Nu'man Al-Ahowl, from Buraib Al-Ijli, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who married a woman on the condition that he teach her a chapter from the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. He said: 'I do not like that he should enter (consume) with her until he has taught her the chapter and given her something.' I said: 'Is it permissible if he gives her a date or a raisin?' He said: 'There is no problem with that if she is pleased with it, whatever it may be.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for consummating marriage when the dowry is teaching Quran?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes that the teaching of a Quranic chapter serves as a valid dower (mahr), permitting the marriage to be consummated only after this instruction is completed and a gift is bestowed. He clarifies that the gift’s value is flexible, accepting even modest items like dates or raisins, provided the wife consents, thereby emphasizing the contractual nature of the dower and the importance of mutual satisfaction in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
Ibn Mahboub, from Al Haris Bin Muhammad Bin Al Noman Al Ahowl, from Bureyd Al Ijaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who married a woman upon a stipulation that he would teach her a Chapter from the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> do not like it that he should copulate with her until he has taught her the Chapter, and gives her something’. I said, ‘Is it allowed if he were to give her a date or a raisin?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with that when she is pleased with it, whatever it may happen to be’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ibn Mahbub has narrated from al-Harith ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu’man al-Ahwal from Burayd al-‘Ijliy who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a man who married a woman to teach her a chapter from the book of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious. He (the Imam) said, ‘I do not like his going with her to bed before teaching her the Chapter and giving her something.’ I then asked if giving dates or raisins is enough. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful if she agrees with whatever it is.’”
